name: Hazel
summary: A household money app in smoked glass, with a card wallet you swipe through and shared pots
about: A seven-page money app for a household of three sharing one account, drawn as smoked glass over soft colour or frosted glass in a light theme. Each person's card sits in a glass wallet: drag one down to slide the next out of the pocket, tap to flip it, freeze it or change its limit. Savings pots fill like glass tubes, and people, activity and insights pages are all working.
how: Open a page from the floating glass bar: Home, Cards, People, Activity, Pots, Insights or Settings
Drag the top card down, or use the arrows, to bring the next card out of the wallet; tap it to flip
Freeze a card, allow online payments, change its limit or press and hold to peek at the PIN
Send money to a person, add or take money from a savings pot, and add payments
Switch the insights range to 7D, 30D or 90D and watch the chart morph
Press Ctrl+K to jump, rename the household and reset demo data in Settings
